newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, stable vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firmer vs dlr, stable vs basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint opened firmer against the dollar on Monday but stable against the central bank's currency basket, dealers said.
The forint opened close to the central bank's resistance level at 179.60/65 to one dollar, up from Friday's close of 180.75.80.
Dealers did not expect any substantial shift from the resistance level.
The forint floats within a 4.5 percent intervention band against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
